step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Bristol Myers Squibb's 'AutoPTP' (Automatic Promote to Production) automated deployment pipeline platform. 1. A user/developer submits a deployment descriptor in JSON format to API Gateway. 2. API Gateway invokes a primary Lambda function that reads the configuration and dynamically generates a CodePipeline workflow. 3. CodePipeline triggers a change approval process integrating ServiceNow and an orchestration/approval Lambda function. 4. The notification Lambda sends status updates via email (represented by the drawn envelope icon, mapped to SES). 5. The pipeline executes dynamic task definitions (N x Task) consisting of sub-CodePipelines, CloudFormation stacks, CodeBuild projects, and CodeDeploy deployments.
